import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { customer } from "../../../backend/schema/customer";

export const customerCms = customizeTable<typeof customer>("customer", {
    icon: "Users",
    display: {
        title: "uuid"
    },
    listFields: ["customerId", "firstName", "lastName", "email", "uuid", "activebool"],
    fields: {
        firstName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        email: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "customerId",
        "firstName",
        "lastName",
        "email",
        "uuid",
        "activebool",
        "active",
        "createDate",
        "lastUpdate",
        "store",
        "address"
    ]
});
